messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert — high 5xx rate observed on dedicated-eu-01 for tenant starlane-prod. 5xx > 40% over last 3m, autoscaler attempts failing. Pager: oncall-amber.
maya.shah: Seeing the alert, joining. Can someone confirm scope? Starlane reports elevated errors from their API integration.
oncall-amber: I'm on it. Initial checks: infer-gpu-2 instance group is at 100% GPU mem, OOM traces in logs. Autoscaler attempted to add nodes but failed with quota error: "insufficient_compute_quota".
eng-sre-tom: Copy. Killing noisy jobs and draining queued requests now. Rolling fallback to model-compact-v1 to relieve KV cache pressure. Will update routing policy if stable.
priya.k: CS — do we have a list of Starlane accounts/contacts affected? Need tailored customer messaging for account teams.
cs-lucas: Drafting now. Affected account buckets: Starlane (Org ID: org-starlane-prod), Starlane-Edge (org-starlane-edge), Starlane-Analytics (org-starlane-analytics). Primary contact map: 
- starlane@starlane.com (PlatformOps)
- edge-ops@starlane.com
- analytics-eng@starlane.com
Will include expected impact, mitigation steps, and ETA.
ops-liz: Paging/forwarding note: Use the enterprise routing list in #customer-ops for these three contacts first, then escalate to AMs if no ack in 10m. Sending to AM-Ryan and Solutions-Edu.
eng-sre-tom: To flip routing to fallback model for starlane tenants run: 
```
POST /admin/routing/update
{ "selector": "org:org-starlane-prod", "route_to": "model:compact-v1", "ttl": 600 }
```
I pushed this to staging, will push to prod in 90s if metrics improve.
maya.shah: Priya/CS — proposed customer-facing status blurb below, please edit: 
"We are investigating elevated errors impacting Starlane API calls to hosted inference in EU. Our mitigation team has applied a temporary routing change to a fallback model to restore availability while we scale capacity; you may see slightly different model outputs during this period. We expect full restoration within 30-45 minutes and will post updates every 15 minutes. If you require direct support, contact starlane@starlane.com."
priya.k: Suggest adding: "No change to data retention or logs; requests are processed but some requests may see degraded latency/throughput." Also include a short internal escalation note for AMs: "Notify legal only if customer reports data corruption or PII issues."
cs-lucas: Updated message accepted. Status page: creating incident entry now — ID INC-1755554320-ST. Will push initial public update with the blurb + note that the issue affects dedicated EU capacity for Starlane.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-1755554320-ST. Severity: P1. Status: investigating.
oncall-amber: Autoscaler quota request submitted to cloud team (ticket CLOU-9987). In parallel, reduced concurrency for heavy embedding routes for Starlane to 1 to reduce memory pressure.
eng-sre-tom: Routing change applied at 1755554450 for org-starlane-prod and org-starlane-edge. Observing 5xx drop to 8% and latency stabilize. Continue monitoring.
ops-liz: Noted — updating ops-runbook: add follow-up to request quota increase and validate scaling policy for dedicated-eu-01.
maya.shah: Good work. CS — send tailored message to the three contact addresses with incident ID, impact, ETA, and workaround (routing to fallback). Use subject: "[Starlane] Incident INC-1755554320 — EU inference disruption".
cs-lucas: Sent initial notice (templates sent). I'll update customers again in 15m or on stabilization.
priya.k: Internal comm snippet for AMs: "Summary: Dedicated EU capacity exhausted causing 5xxs for Starlane. Mitigation: temporary routing to compact model + reduced concurrency. ETA: 30-45m to full capacity after quota approval. Postmortem to follow."
eng-sre-tom: Metrics look healthy now; keeping incident open for validation window (30m).
oncall-amber: Handoff: I'm oncall for next 30m then handing to eng-sre-tom for post-incident checks.
maya.shah: Reminder: include root cause note in status: quota prevented autoscaler from adding capacity. Postmortem owners: eng-sre-tom, ops-liz.
incident-bot: Incident severity unchanged. Last update at 1755554665: mitigation successful, monitoring.
cs-lucas: Final customer note draft prepared for when we transition to resolved: "Update: Traffic restored via temporary routing and capacity adjustments. We will monitor and confirm full restoration after quota approval. Apologies for the disruption — our team will follow up with an RCA."
priya.k: Thanks everyone. Action items: (1) ops-liz to file quota increase, (2) eng-sre-tom to validate autoscaler retry behavior for quota failures, (3) cs-lucas to coordinate customer follow-ups.
maya.shah: Closing handoff. Leave incident thread open for RCA comments. :white_check_mark:
